scenes.title: A post should become a public record.
scenes.visual: Licensed issue photo with an explicitly illustrative label; problem headline. No invented impact numbers.
scenes.narration: A broken footpath. An overflowing drain. A streetlight that stays dark. People share these problems, but the post often disappears before anyone knows what happened. And a complaint marked resolved does not always mean the problem is fixed.

scenes.title: Namma Civic, by Tri-Fusion
scenes.visual: Existing product title and schematic ward illustration, with an explicit Selected theme: Sustainability & Social Impact badge. Preserve the Report / Discuss / Act / Verify sequence.
scenes.narration: We are Tri-Fusion. Our selected theme is Sustainability and Social Impact. Namma Civic connects local reporting, community discussion and citizen verification, keeping civic problems visible from first report to evidenced outcome.

scenes.title: Capture. Review. Share.
scenes.visual: Genuine deployed composer capture. Show the actual media, voice, category, language and location controls, with the device-only banner and disabled AI control visible. No saved-post result or live model response is claimed.
scenes.footage: Genuine historical UI still crops: assets/captures/02a-composer-top.png and 02b-composer-location.png
scenes.narration: Start with New issue. A resident can take a photo, add a written observation, or record a private voice note. With permission, the app captures a fresh device location. The citizen reviews the description and media before sharing. The deployed preview provides a device sandbox: posts stay in that browser. Live AI rewriting and sharing across citizens require the connected service. The controls shown here are captured from the actual deployed prototype.

scenes.title: Build a neighbourhood conversation.
scenes.visual: Genuine deployed People opt-in and fictional directory screen. No outgoing request, comment, reaction or saved-post mutation is shown as verified.
scenes.narration: Reporting becomes a conversation. People can react, comment and save an issue. The People page lets citizens opt in to discovery and choose whether to connect. In this demonstration, the profiles are fictional and requests stay in this browser. Explore a ward to discover local records without mixing social reactions with verified civic outcomes.

scenes.title: Claimed is different from verified.
scenes.visual: Genuine /issue/demo-issue-007 illustrative evidence comparison, fictional verification history and public demonstration ledger. Read-only record inspection; no live vote or transition is performed.
scenes.footage: Genuine historical UI stills: 03b-before-after.png, 04-citizen-verification.png and 05-ledger.png; read-only inspection
scenes.narration: A social feed alone is not enough. Open an issue to inspect its timeline, evidence and current status. In the connected workflow, an officer submits repair evidence, and eligible reporting or supporting citizens confirm or dispute the claim. Shared application rules determine whether the issue is verified or reopened. Silence never closes it. The ledger distinguishes claimed fixes from verified outcomes. The example histories and their totals are fictional demonstration data.

scenes.title: Live Firebase frontend; connected backend next.
scenes.visual: Official Google/Firebase icon architecture separates Firebase Hosting Spark static frontend LIVE, verified 18 October 2026, from intended connected backend services that are undeployed and unverified. Show implemented backend schema/repair/fallback checks without presenting a live model result.
scenes.narration: Firebase Hosting now serves our device-only frontend on the Spark plan. Public access was verified on October eighteenth, twenty twenty-six. The remaining diagram shows implemented integration architecture. Firebase Authentication is intended for sessions. Our Hono API is packaged for Cloud Run. Firestore and Cloud Storage would hold shared records and sanitized media. These connected backend services are not deployed. Vertex AI and Gemini are intended to assist transcription, wording, classification, duplicate comparison and photo observations. Their live use and model quality remain unverified. Application code checks schemas, allows one repair and then a deterministic fallback. Code also computes wards, priority, service targets, verification and every public metric. Only the static frontend is live.

scenes.title: A focused prototype. A measurable next step.
scenes.visual: Current device-only demo capabilities beside next pilot steps: deploy and verify the connected backend; one ward pilot; moderation and official onboarding. Firebase Hosting frontend is already live. No full-scale availability claims.
scenes.narration: This is a focused demonstration, not a full-scale government deployment. Next, we will connect and verify backend services, involve one ward’s residents and officials, and measure real outcomes. When outreach is configured, messages require the citizen’s final confirmation. The app does not promise a response.

challengeDescription: Build an AI-powered solution that addresses a meaningful environmental or societal challenge. Solutions may focus on improving resource efficiency, increasing accessibility, strengthening resilience, supporting communities, or enabling more informed and sustainable decision-making.
projectProblemStatement: Residents struggle to turn everyday civic problems into clear, actionable reports and to track whether a fix actually happened. Namma Civic connects accessible local reporting, community discussion, evidence-backed responses and citizen verification in one public record.
